AUS blu-ray has Hardcoded English subtitles for foreign dialogue and GER disc doesn't.

There are 3 scenes taken out of the GER blu-ray, presumably because they are graphic/violent.
It shouldn't affect the overall plot. For example, instead of explicitly seeing the guy getting whipped, it is implied to happen off-screen.

Unfortunately the AUS blu-ray isn't much of a suitable replacement because the video is cropped so much it's barely watchable.

I'll write a small overview of the scenes that are cut out of the GER blu-ray, and put the timecodes. They probably contain spoilers so read at your own risk.

I haven't seen the movie so I'm not sure if they are guards or police or what they are. I'll just put guards.

Scene 1 (~15 seconds)
AUS blu-ray - 29:06 - 29:21
GER blu-ray - 28:29

The guard is shown holding a pencil up to the man's ear. In the GER cut, this is where it cuts to the next scene. In the original cut, the shot goes out of focus, and the guard stabs him in the ear with the pencil. He screams out in pain and then it cuts to the next scene.



Scene 2 (~15 seconds)
AUS blu-ray - 36:31 - 36:46
GER blu-ray - 35:48

The guard asks the prisoner to co-operate, and when he won't, the guard looks at the other guard and says "Again." and then it cuts to the next scene. In the original cut, after saying "Again", the guard whips him multiple times while the prisoner screams in pain. The reactions of the guards are shown, and blood pools on the floor beneath him. Then it cuts to the next scene.



Scene 3 (~4 seconds)
AUS blu-ray - 1:00:35 - 1:00:39
GER blu-ray - 59:37

In the original cut there is a shot of a girl's face, and it cuts away right before she's shot in the head. There are 2 more gunshots off-screen. In the GER cut, the shot of the girl's face and the first gunshot is taken out, so it only has the 2 off-screen gunshots.
